split.description: Train the encoding map on the original five-person 1,000-sentence baseline response set; evaluate on the original three-person 1,500-sentence search set. The 1,000 baseline sentences recur across people; only the 500 drive/suppress sentences are new stimuli. New nested splits are extensions.

inputs.description: Predictor inputs are the original sentence text/source representations and permitted original training-participant responses. Author comparator uses GPT2-XL last-token layer22 plus ridge. Item IDs are joining identifiers only, not model covariates. B/D/S condition labels and any metadata revealing heldout response-selection condition are evaluator-side companion-scoring metadata, not additional prediction features. Final response columns and saved author predictions remain evaluator-owned; historical public exposure is disclosed.

preprocessing.description: Match the released GLMsingle response extraction and bySessVoxZ normalization; retain the functionally localized lang_LH_netw target rather than switching to an anatomical ROI or a voxel subset. Source script records the exact extraction parameter identifiers.

metric.description: Pearson correlation r=sum((prediction-mean(prediction))*(response-mean(response)))/sqrt(sum((prediction-mean(prediction))^2)*sum((response-mean(response))^2)) across the original 1,500 sentence items.

aggregation.description: Select lang_LH_netw, participants797,841,880 and every original item1..1500 exactly once per person. Average normalized response_target over the three people for each item, then Pearson-correlate with one candidate prediction per item. Retain baseline1..1000 and original drive/suppress subsets as source companions and participant diagnostics. Do not pool4500rows as independent observations.
